title: list_jobs inputSchema
description: Argument shape for enumerating the caller's geoprocessing jobs (newest first) with an optional status filter and cursor paging. The bare standard taxonomy models job lookup as a job-resource read; the reference implementation exposes a discrete listing tool (advertised name honua_list_jobs). x-honua-extension: this is a documented Honua extension over the bare taxonomy, pending formalization in the geospatial-mcp standard. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

status.description: Optional job status filter. When omitted, jobs of any status are returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return on this page (capped at 200).

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as nextCursor by a previous call.
